description: This file defines interfaces for system management, discovery, configuration, lifetime management, and metadata within the WPEFramework project. It declares multiple abstract classes (interfaces) with various methods that are intended to be implemented elsewhere, likely by plugins or system components. The file uses macros and annotations for JSON serialization and licensing information.

classes.name: ISystemManagement
classes.description: Interface for system management actions such as rebooting, deleting data, cloning plugins, and fetching environment variables.

classes.name: IDiscovery
classes.description: Interface for network discovery processes, initiating SSDP discovery and obtaining results.

classes.name: IConfiguration
classes.description: Interface for configuration management, including persisting configuration and retrieving settings by callsign.

classes.name: ILifeTime
classes.description: Interface for lifecycle and state management of plugins, including activation, deactivation, suspend, resume, and notifications.

classes.name: ILifeTime::INotification
classes.description: Notification interface for plugin state changes.

classes.name: IMetadata
classes.description: Interface providing metadata about running plugins, connections, process info, and version details.

methods.name: Reboot
methods.description: Reboots the device.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Removes contents of a specified directory from persistent storage.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a clone of a plugin with a new callsign.

methods.name: Environment
methods.description: Provides the value of a specified environment variable.

methods.name: StartDiscovery
methods.description: Initiates SSDP network discovery with a specified TTL.

methods.name: DiscoveryResults
methods.description: Retrieves SSDP network discovery results.

methods.name: Persist
methods.description: Stores the current configuration to persistent memory.

methods.name: Configuration (getter)
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration value for a given callsign.

methods.name: Configuration (setter)
methods.description: Sets the configuration for a given callsign.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification sink for lifetime events.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a notification sink for lifetime events.

methods.name: Activate
methods.description: Activates the specified plugin.

methods.name: Deactivate
methods.description: Deactivates the specified plugin.

methods.name: Unavailable
methods.description: Marks a plugin as unavailable.

methods.name: Hibernate
methods.description: Puts a plugin into Hibernate state for a specified timeout.

methods.name: Suspend
methods.description: Suspends the specified plugin.

methods.name: Resume
methods.description: Resumes the specified plugin.

methods.name: Proxies
methods.description: Provides details of currently running proxies.

methods.name: Status
methods.description: Provides status of a plugin, including configurations.

methods.name: Links
methods.description: Provides details of active connections.

methods.name: ProcessInfo
methods.description: Provides framework process information.

methods.name: Subsystems
methods.description: Provides details of active subsystems.

methods.name: Version
methods.description: Provides version information of WPEFramework.

methods.name: CallStack
methods.description: Provides callstack info for a thread index.
